provenance.summary: Product preference for Seedance, Wan and Kling video families, relevant alternatives and Pika on request. Exact entries require review; this is not a measured quality benchmark or execution certification.
Higgsfield defaults video to Seedance 2.5 and reserves many models for explicit requests. This is vendor policy, not an independent ranking or evidence for our other family preferences.
